notes.title: Update 3.2.0
notes.content:
New feature: Story Mode! 📖
3.2.0 offers a whole new way to play Rumble Arena with this story mode! The first book is called: "Vengful Djinn". Complete this book with 10 missions, each page has a different fight and an awesome reward!

Friendly Matches
We worked hard to fix the crashes during Friendly Match and in the game creation lobby. This build is definitly more stable. 

More
Also a lot of small bugs and quality/performance improvements have been made. Like: chest animation fix, rewards balancing for Ranked ELO Progression, sound added etc..

We expect that the story mode will be a very nice way to play Rumble, but we will monitor your feedback in the coming weeks. Thanks again everyone for giving feedback and reporting bugs. This is very important to improve the quality of Rumble Arena. 

⚔️ Happy Rumbling! ⚔️

notes.title: New update 2.3.4 for Rumble Arena!
Update 2.3.3 Rumble Arena
New update with better performance and bug fixes!
Rumble Arena update 2.3
Update 2.0.2
Update 2.0 - New user interface and a new character; Athena
notes.content:
Hi all, the 2.0.0 version is live! The leaderboards has been reset and the rewards has been handed out!

We thank you all for this amazing first season. It's been a long 3.5 last months we worked really hard and completely overhauled the UI and created a new character: Athena. Thank you all for this great journey and let's make season 2 even more epic than season 1! We have a lot of great memories from season 1, especially the tournaments they were awesome watch and sometimes participate. Season 2 is going to bring a lot of interesting new content to the game. We keep you all posted.

But now, let's get excited for 2.0.0, it includes:
* New UI - The complete overhaul of our UI! Yes it's looking quite awesome, we're proud on it and it was 3 months work, but it's finally finished and hopefully you'll enjoy it as much as us, below a screenshot.
* Athena - The Goddess of Wisdom! She has medium ranged attacks with her spear. Thanks to her shield she has on some attacks superarmor and reflects projectiles during some attacks! This combination makes her a strong warrior and great zoner! 
* Gameplay FPS improvements - A lot of optimising for older devices has been done, hopefully this results in better FPS, but we'll continue optimising FPS during season 2 as well!

Update 2-2-20: there are some small bugs in the new UI that will be fixed in the upcoming update 2.0.1

notes.title: Update 1.6.1 - A lot of fixes and improvements (new way of edgeguarding)
Update 1.6.0 is out now! Play now with our newest character Imoogi in the new arena "Fallen Temple"
notes.content:
Update notes:
- New playable legend: Imoogi, the legendary Korean dragon! 
- New arena: Fallen Temple, new layout and good setup for combo's!
- Performance improvements!
- Tilt attacks easier to execute!
- New air dodge mechanic, now fast/slow air dodging based on whether an attack hits or not!

We just released the update 1.6.0 on all stores: Play Store, App Store and Steam!! Imoogi is the newest addition to the game together with an amazing new arena called "Fallen Temple". With all builds working again we can focus on balancing and improvements (since we did update Unity there might be some new bugs). So 1.6.1 will contain a lot of improvements like cooldowns on projectiles and balancing. After that, for 2.0.0 We've something very cool planned: Seasons. Also 2.0.0 will bring our first Echo fighter to the roster (a fighter who shares similar moves with another fighter but with unique specials, movement and appearance). We'll come with more information about seasons after 1.6.1. For 2.0.0 it's important to know that the top xxx on the leaderboards will be rewarded a unique item!

notes.title: Explanation: How our hitboxes and network code works!
notes.content:
Hi everyone :)

[i]Thanks so much for trying out Rumble Arena. We are a super small team with a dream: creating a fun, fair and competitive brawling game for everyone. This means wether you're on mobile, PC or in the future on console, you'll all be able to play together and tryout some cool combo's the game offers the more you play it. The game will forever be FREE to play without any pay to win elements, you can quote us on that. We hope you give the game a chance and before you review it, please read below to understand why we made some of the decisions.[/i]

[h1]So why are the hitboxes so big and why only 1 hitbox for each attack?
[/h1]In order to make a multiplayer brawling game for all devices, including mobile, we had to create the network code in such a way, that even devices on 100+ ping could play a fun match! After years of trying (the single player version of Rumble Arena released in 2015) we came across [b]Quantum[/b] a new product of ExitGames. This technique is still new and not everything is supported yet, we're working now on having better hitboxes for a future version, most likely 1.7.0 since we're talking with the development team of quantum how to achieve this. 

[h1]So why Quantum?
[/h1]With Quantum, only the input of every player is send over the network. This makes the network packages small and fast. After the input of a player is received by the other players, locally the device re-simulates the frames in between the input being sent and received to calculate the actual outcome of the game for those frames. This means for example: if player A blocks at frame 50, and the input is received by player B on frame 55, but player B attacked player A on frame 53. On device A the player sees he blocked the attack, but on device B the player sees his attack hits. With quantum, after receiving the input from player A on frame 55, the frames in between get's recalculated and both players see the actual outcome of the game: Player A blocked the attack! A new era of gaming. This system is called [u]determinism[/u]. 

[h1]So when can we expect a more precise hitbox system?
[/h1]We're a small team working on a free-to-play game that will stay free to play. We are working every weekend and evening to get more things in the game. Our current estimation is within 3 months to overhaul the attack system. You can follow our tasks that we do daily on this website: [url=https://trello.com/b/Va7fBJKj/rumble-arena-super-smash-legends]Trello[/url]. To track what we work on and which version.

Kind regards,
Kevin Vermaat
